method: robust SH-L2 regression of skin radiance against the neural normals
status: MEASURED FROM THE FOOTAGE. Replaces the hand-written frontal-key guess.
normalisation: mean irradiance over the sampled normals = 1

conditioning.warning: The visible surface of a bust shot has ny < 0 everywhere, so the fit has NO data about light arriving from behind. dominant_direction_world is therefore an extrapolation and must not be read as a measurement -- on this shot it reports a source behind the performer, which is an artefact of that extrapolation, not a finding. The IRRADIANCE FIELD over the sampled normals is well determined and is the only thing consumed.

comparison_with_the_old_guess.interpretation: Compared over the visible normals, both mean-normalised. A large spread ratio means the real plate is far more DIRECTIONALLY lit than the hand-written soft key allowed, which is what the ratio stages were getting wrong.

degeneracy: albedo and lighting scale are not separable and do not need to be: E_source is only ever a ratio denominator against the same albedo.
generality: needs only plate, matte and normals -- no on-set reference, no per-artist calibration.
